verdict.rationale: Jules has a programmatic API with API keys. It can 'automate tasks like bug fixing', and an optional automationMode creates PRs automatically, so a CI pipeline could call it to open fix PRs. A community user also confirms dispatching tasks to Jules programmatically through the API. However, there is no documented native CI/CD integration or build-failure trigger, so developers must write their own glue code; GitHub issue labels are the only other built-in trigger. Missing for 10: a first-party CI/CD integration (e.g. a pipeline action or build-failure hook), documentation of feeding failing test or build logs to the agent, and hands-on evidence of CI-triggered fixes.
